title: Ride the Koblenz cable car to Ehrenbreitstein Fortress
place: Koblenz cable car and Ehrenbreitstein Fortress
description: Cross the Rhine in a panoramic cable-car cabin, then enter the hilltop fortress to walk its courtyards, ramparts and terraces above the Deutsches Eck.

title: Cruise the Sognefjord from Bergen to Flåm
description: Leave Bergen by passenger boat and follow the coast into Norway's longest fjord, passing island channels and mountain villages before reaching Flåm.

title: Walk among the timber houses of Chochołów village
description: Follow the single village road between bright log houses whose walls are traditionally scrubbed each year, preserving a living example of Podhale timber architecture. The linked day tour includes only a brief 15-minute village stop.
